evals.prompt: Run a CEO review for the current business.
evals.expected_output: A review saved via `npm run hq -- save-review`, visible on /ceo and in the vault, with the fixed sections.
expectations: Called the HQ status API before deciding anything
Read the brain (`npm run hq -- brain read <slug> ceo` and `brain show <slug>`) before deciding
Saved the review with `npm run hq -- save-review <slug>` (not by writing into the site's files directly)
The review has Headline, Decisions for you, This week, Delegated and Watching sections
Lists at most 5 decisions for the owner
Every skill it names has ready: true in the status JSON
Promotes nothing to the HQ brain without the owner's yes, and any proposed promotion names no business

evals.prompt: /hq:ceo plan the week for content and SEO only
evals.expected_output: A review focused on the content and seo departments that still surfaces any critical finding.
expectations: The This week section only covers Content & Social and SEO & GEO
Any critical finding from the status JSON still appears
